anchors.title: Cataract Gorge Reserve
anchors.description: Wilderness reserve a 10-minute walk from the CBD. Cross the suspension bridge, ride the world's longest single-span chairlift across the gorge, and swim in the heritage First Basin pool.

anchors.title: Queen Victoria Museum & Art Gallery
anchors.description: Australia's largest regional museum across two sites. The Royal Park building covers art and the city's colonial history; the Inveresk Tramway Workshops focus on natural science and a planetarium.

anchors.title: Tamar Island Wetlands
anchors.description: Free 5km return boardwalk through reedbeds and wetlands on the Tamar River. Spot platypus at dusk and 70+ bird species year-round. Visitor Centre with rangers on weekends.

anchors.title: Tamar Valley Wine Route
anchors.description: 30 cellar doors along the Tamar River north of the city — including Josef Chromy, Holm Oak and Bay of Fires. Cool-climate Pinot Noir, sparkling wine and Riesling are the regional specialties.

anchors.title: City Park & The Monkeys
anchors.description: Heritage Victorian gardens in the centre of town, home to the famous Macaque Monkey Enclosure — a 1980 gift from Launceston's sister city of Ikeda, Japan. Free.

SATURDAY.title: Harvest Launceston Community Farmers Market
SATURDAY.description: Every Saturday morning on Cimitiere Street. 60+ Tasmanian growers and producers — no resellers. 8:30am-12:30pm year-round.
